    - branch `clarify_requirements`:
      - `agent` uses `ask_clarification`.
    - branch `requirements_already_clear`: none.
  - `agent` uses `search_web`.
  - `agent` uses `fetch_source`.
  - `agent` uses `write_report`.
  - `agent` uses `read_saved_file`.
